meta.title: Catch And Tame breeding recipes data

sources.label: Catch And Tame! Wiki - Breeding Hints

meta.notes: The current standalone Catch and Tame wiki presents 8 breeding recipes. Fandom has a larger older Breeding Hints table and BloxInformer has partial/TBA rows; this dataset uses the current 8-row list and records conflicts in private notes.

items.name: Galaxy Kitsune
items.recipeRole: First mythic-chain output for Celestial Axolotl progress.
items.cardSummary: Use this recipe when building the upper mythic chain; the result later pairs with Galaxy Axolotl.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed result card from BloxInformer animal/recipe art

items.name: Galaxy Axolotl
items.recipeRole: Second mythic-chain output for Celestial Axolotl progress.
items.cardSummary: Use this recipe alongside Galaxy Kitsune production before attempting Celestial Axolotl.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed result card from BloxInformer animal/recipe art

items.name: Celestial Griffin
items.recipeRole: Mythic output used as a high-rarity breeding target.
items.cardSummary: A separate mythic recipe that needs Cosmic Griffin before it can be attempted.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed result card cropped from Fandom Breeding Hints row image

items.name: Celestial Axolotl
items.recipeRole: Mid-chain mythic result that depends on two earlier mythic breeds.
items.cardSummary: Plan this after both galaxy recipes are running, because both parents are bred results.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed result card cropped from Fandom Breeding Hints row image

items.name: Hydra
items.cardSummary: This recipe matters because Hydra becomes one half of the highest-BPS breed route.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom and BloxInformer cross-check
items.imageStatus: source-backed result card from BloxInformer animal/recipe art

items.name: Celestial Hydra
items.cardSummary: This is the main endgame breeding target when the goal is raw income potential.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom confirms result, BloxInformer has the parents but leaves result TBA
items.imageStatus: source-backed golden result card cropped from Fandom Breeding Hints row image; source file title is Inferno Hydra

items.name: Giraffe
items.recipeRole: Lower-tier rare breed outside the mythic chain.
items.cardSummary: Use this as an earlier rare-breed target before committing pens to the mythic chain.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row; Fandom cross-check; BloxInformer has parent typo and TBA result
items.imageStatus: source-backed result card cropped from Fandom Breeding Hints row image

items.name: Toad
items.recipeRole: Lower-tier gameplay-confirmed breed outside the mythic chain.
items.cardSummary: Treat this as a current standalone-wiki recipe, but expect older recipe tables to show a different result.
items.sourceStatus: Current standalone wiki row conflicts with Fandom and BloxInformer, which list Gorilla for the same parents
items.imageStatus: text-only; no clean source-backed Toad row image found and older sources show Gorilla for this pair
